eventDescription:
Vidhaigal Organization, along with the National Service Scheme (NSS) students of SRM University, jointly carried out a cleanliness drive at the premises of Arulmigu Marundeeswarar Temple in Thirukachur.
As part of the initiative to enhance the greenery of the temple premises, various flowering plants and tree saplings were also planted.
The small initiatives we take today can create a significant positive impact in the future and help us face the challenges of climate change.
